from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RetainedEarningsRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single retained earnings figure found in one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    report_fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of the report document itself")
    data_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the retained earnings amount applies to")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The retained earnings amount as a numeric value")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount (e.g., USD)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    retained_earnings_records: list[RetainedEarningsRecord]
